summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new 'Où est mon colis ?' tracking feature. 18/18 pytest tests pass. All API contracts verified against public URL. Frontend /suivi flows (search, error banner, deep-link, timeline, ETA, items) all work. Navbar + Footer links present. Payin regression confirmed: order is inserted with tracking_step='ordered' + tracking_history before Paxity 401.

PUT /tracking/{order_id} has no auth — noted as merchant endpoint but publicly reachable; consider adding an admin token in a future iteration (not blocking for current MVP).
seed_data_creation: Created one payin-driven order via POST /api/paxity/payin (returns 401 from Paxity as expected) to verify tracking_step insertion. Demo order ord_demo12345678 left untouched (no PUT executed on it).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_tracking.py are stable. DO NOT run test_paxity.py (it overwrites .env). Demo order still at step 'customs' — safe.
